name: Can I perform small deck structural repairs myself, or should I always hire a professional?

mainEntity.name: Can I perform small deck structural repairs myself, or should I always hire a professional?

acceptedAnswer.text: While minor cosmetic repairs like replacing a few deck boards or tightening loose fasteners might be feasible for a skilled homeowner, any repair involving the deck's structural integrity, such as compromised beams, posts, or ledger boards, should always be handled by a qualified professional. Improper structural repairs can lead to serious safety hazards and may not meet local building codes. A professional ensures the work is done safely and correctly.
acceptedAnswer.description: Minor cosmetic repairs can be DIY, but any structural integrity issues require a professional. Improper repairs can create safety hazards.
